onb.ai.key-hint: The key is stored in the Windows Credential Manager, never in a file.
onb.ai.lead: Connect a provider to get a summary, decisions and tasks at the end of every meeting. Only the transcript text is sent — audio, never. Without it, everything works just the same.
onb.ai.none-note: You can connect one later, in Settings → Intelligence.
onb.ai.title: AI summaries.
onb.done.lead: It lives in the Windows tray, next to the clock. The Home screen shows what's still worth setting up; all of this can be changed later in Settings.
onb.done.model-downloading: downloading — it'll be ready by itself
onb.done.model-missing: none yet — the Home screen helps you download one
onb.done.title: ISPer is ready.
onb.mic.hint: In meetings, the participants' audio comes from Windows itself — there's nothing to set up for that.
onb.mic.lead: The bar should move with your voice. Nothing is recorded — it's only the sound level. This microphone is used for dictation and for your side of meetings.
onb.mic.no-audio: This microphone isn't delivering any sound. Check that it's plugged in and allowed in Windows Settings → Privacy → Microphone, or pick another one above.
onb.mic.silent: The microphone is sending pure silence. It may be muted (a button or key on the headset itself) or blocked in Windows Settings → Privacy → Microphone.
onb.mic.title: Say something.
onb.model.lead-cpu: Whisper transcribes on your computer, and this ISPer build runs on the CPU. The recommended model is light and fast enough for dictation. It's downloaded only once.
onb.model.lead-gpu: Whisper transcribes on your computer, and this ISPer build uses your NVIDIA graphics card. The recommended model is the best balance of quality and speed. It's downloaded only once.
onb.model.progress: {done} of {total} MB · {pct}% — you can continue while it downloads
onb.model.title: Choose the model.
onb.sc.busy: That shortcut is taken by another program — ISPer is using {label}.
onb.sc.lead: In any text field — Teams, e-mail, the browser — hold the shortcut while you speak. When you release it, the text is pasted where the cursor was. A quick tap turns on hands-free mode: speak freely and ISPer pastes by itself after a pause.
onb.sc.no-model: Without a model, dictation can't transcribe yet. Go back one step to download one.
onb.sc.none: No free shortcut — choose another one below.
onb.sc.title: Hold, speak, release.
onb.sc.try-label: Try it here: click the field, hold the shortcut and say a sentence.
onb.sc.try-ph: the dictated text shows up here…
onb.sc.wait-model: The model is still loading — the test works as soon as it's ready.
onb.sc.worked: It worked ✓ — that's how it works in any app.
onb.welcome.lead: Dictation in any app and meeting transcription, on your computer. Four short steps get ISPer ready: microphone, transcription model, shortcut and, if you want, AI.
onb.welcome.promise: 100% local: audio never leaves your machine. Transcription runs right here, and AI only comes in if you connect one — and even then, only with the text.
onb.welcome.title: Welcome to ISPer.

settings.diag.env-missing: no {vars} in the process — folders resolved through the Windows API
settings.diag.retention-days: deletes whatever is older than {n} days
settings.ditado.diga-nova-linha-novo-par: Voice commands work in Portuguese speech. Say nova linha (new line), novo parágrafo (new paragraph), ponto final (period), vírgula (comma), ponto de interrogação (question mark), ponto de exclamação (exclamation mark), dois pontos (colon), ponto e vírgula (semicolon), reticências (ellipsis), abre/fecha parênteses (parentheses), abre/fecha aspas (quotes), travessão (dash), arroba (@). At the end of the dictation: apagar isso discards everything; tudo em maiúsculas / tudo em minúsculas changes the case.
settings.ditado.esses-termos-sao-mostrad: These terms are shown to Whisper before every transcription, and whatever it still gets slightly wrong ("ísper", "opt solve") is corrected to the exact spelling — in dictation and in meetings.
settings.ditado.gravar-atalho-clique-pre: "Record shortcut": click and press the combination (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+K). Letters, numbers, F1–F12 and Space, with at least one modifier; F-keys can go alone. If another program already uses the combination, ISPer tells you and uses the next free one.
settings.ditado.pressione-combinacao-qui: press the key combination you want
settings.ditado.vale-ditado-canal-eu-reu: Used for dictation and for the "Me" channel in meetings. If the chosen device isn't connected at the time, ISPer uses the default one and notes it in the log.
settings.inteligencia.biblioteca-botao-s: In the Library, the "Semantic" button starts finding meetings and dictations by meaning ("when did we talk about the budget?"), not just by the exact word. Every saved meeting and every pasted dictation is indexed automatically; "Index everything" covers older history and rebuilds the index when the model changes. Only the text of the chunks and of the question is sent to the provider — with Ollama, not even that leaves the machine.
settings.inteligencia.casual-tom-natural: Casual — natural tone, like a message to colleagues
settings.inteligencia.catalogos-mudam-va: Catalogs change (and vary per account): "List models" asks the API with your key and fills in the field's options.
settings.inteligencia.chave-vai-credenti: The key goes to Windows Credential Manager — never to a file. Only the transcript text is sent to the API; audio, never.
settings.inteligencia.cole-chave-clique-: paste the key and click Save key
settings.inteligencia.compativel-openai-: OpenAI-compatible — local Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Mistral…
settings.inteligencia.durante-reuniao-pe: During the meeting, ask the AI what is pending, what I promised and what was decided
settings.inteligencia.emb-key: Key (only if the endpoint requires one)
settings.inteligencia.gemini-free-tier-u: Gemini (free tier) — uses the Gemini key above
settings.inteligencia.ollama-local-http-: Local Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1 with ollama pull nomic-embed-text (or bge-m3, multilingual) — nothing leaves the machine and no key is needed. OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1 + key.
settings.inteligencia.polir-ditados-ia-a: Polish dictations with AI before pasting
settings.inteligencia.so-limpeza-tira-he: Clean-up only — removes hesitations and fixes punctuation, without changing the tone
settings.inteligencia.usa-provider-acima: Uses the provider above. Each round sends the last ~15 minutes of transcript (text only) and updates the "Live insights" panel on the Home meeting card. Rounds without new speech are skipped; "Refresh now" forces one. When off, the panel still accepts one-off rounds.
Uses the provider above; only the dictated text is sent. Adds about a second before pasting. If the API fails or there's no key, the original text is pasted as usual — the history keeps both.
settings.inteligencia.vazio-ollama-cole-: empty for Ollama; paste and save for OpenAI/Mistral
settings.modelos-whisper.baixados-huggin: Downloaded from Hugging Face with SHA-256 verification to %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.isper.desktop\models. Select the one you want and click Save — it switches without a restart.

settings.reunioes.abrir-arquivo-md-progr: Open the .md file in the default program
settings.reunioes.atalho-global-marcar-m: Global shortcut to mark a moment (during the meeting)
settings.reunioes.automatico-ctrl-alt-c-: (automatic — Ctrl+Alt+C or the next free one)
settings.reunioes.automatico-ctrl-alt-k-: (automatic — Ctrl+Alt+K or the next free one)
settings.reunioes.automatico-ctrl-alt-m-: (automatic — Ctrl+Alt+M or the next free one)
settings.reunioes.avisar-quando-chamada-: Notify me when a call starts and ask whether to record (default)
settings.reunioes.distancia-maxima-entre: Maximum distance between two voices for them to count as the same person. Changing this without comparing the results usually makes it worse — prefer giving the number of participants above.
settings.reunioes.gravar-automaticamente: Record automatically when joining a call (and stop when it ends)
settings.reunioes.identificacao-falantes: Speaker identification also sends a silent notification when it finishes.
settings.reunioes.informar-numero-mais-a: Giving the number helps the most: without it, clustering decides by the distance between voices, and in a long meeting it ends up creating too many people. With the number, it splits into exactly that many.
settings.reunioes.isper-percebe-chamada-: ISPer notices the call through Windows audio sessions: during a call, Teams keeps the microphone open. No bot, no Teams API — and nothing is recorded unless you ask, except in automatic mode. Remember to tell the participants (privacy laws such as LGPD apply).
settings.reunioes.ligado-por-padrao-ence: On by default. When the meeting ends, ISPer transcribes the whole audio again more carefully — cuts guided by voice detection, beam search, context across chunks and speaker per word — and replaces the transcript that appeared live. It takes a few minutes per hour of meeting, in the background; the live transcript stays in place if anything fails.
settings.reunioes.modelos-instalados-par: With the models installed, "Participants" becomes "Participant 1", "Participant 2"… — pyannote + 3D-Speaker via sherpa-onnx, 100% local, when the meeting ends.
settings.reunioes.nada-fica-so-bibliotec: Nothing — it just stays in the Library
settings.reunioes.notificacao-windows-cl: Windows notification — clicking it opens the Library (default)
settings.reunioes.pressione-combinacao-q: press the key combination you want
press the key combination you want
press the key combination you want
settings.reunioes.quantos-participantes-: How many participants the meeting usually has
settings.reunioes.refazer-transcricao-en: Redo the transcription when the meeting ends (final pass)
settings.reunioes.so-teams-usa-process-l: "Teams only" uses Windows process loopback — it ignores notifications, music and other apps. If Teams isn't open at the time, ISPer falls back to the whole system and says so on the indicator.
settings.reunioes.toque-registra-instant: One tap records the instant (a "marked moment"): moments show up in the Library and the Markdown, and they guide the AI summary. There's also a mark-moment button on the indicator and on the Home screen.
settings.reunioes.traz-copilot-frente-el: Brings Copilot to the front; if it's already in front, hides it. Whatever you typed in the chat and the notes stays there. There's also a Copilot button on the indicator and on the Home screen.
settings.sistema.avisar-quando-houver-ve: Tell me when there's a new version (on launch and once a day)
settings.sistema.copia-integra-banco-reu: A consistent copy of the database (meetings, dictations, semantic index) in Documents\ISPer\Backups, even with the app open. To restore: close ISPer and copy the file over %APPDATA%\ISPer\isper.db.
settings.sistema.inicio-windows-isper-na: When starting with Windows, ISPer starts quietly in the tray; the Home screen also opens with a click on the tray icon.
settings.sistema.logs-ficam-localappdata: Logs live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.isper.desktop\logs (one JSON file per day, 14 days). When asking for help, send the exported .zip: diagnostics, settings (no keys), versions, metrics and the last three logs — lines containing dictated text are removed first. None of this is sent on its own.
settings.sistema.mostrar-tela-inicio-abr: Show the Home screen when opening ISPer
settings.sistema.onboarding-hint: Microphone, model, shortcut and AI, step by step — like the first time.
settings.sistema.padrao-sempre-nada-apag: The default is forever: nothing is deleted unless you pick a limit here and confirm. With a limit, ISPer deletes from the database and from the Meetings folder whatever is older — on launch, once a day and when you shorten the limit —, and before deleting it writes an automatic backup to Documents\ISPer\Backups (the last three are kept). Transcripts are personal data about you and about everyone in the meeting (privacy laws such as LGPD apply).
settings.sistema.reimportstate: If a meeting disappeared from the Library but its .md is still in Documents\ISPer\Reunioes, this brings it back — with speech, times, speakers and summary. The Markdown is written before the database, so it's the copy that survives. Repeating is safe: whatever is already in the Library is skipped.
settings.sistema.retyes: Yes, delete what's past the limit
settings.sistema.ui-lang-hint: Changes ISPer's text right away: windows, tray and notifications. The speech language (what Whisper transcribes) is under Dictation.
settings.sistema.updates-hint: . Updates come signed from ISPer's releases on GitHub; the download only happens when you ask.
settings.sistema.vale-hora-inicio-biblio: Applies right away to Home, the Library and Settings. The floating indicator and Copilot always stay dark — they float over other apps and need their own contrast.
